1967 is a common year (not a leap year).  
Subtract 257 days from 1967-09-10.  
September 10 minus 10 days → August 31 (remaining 247 days).  
August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, etc. Count back:  
Aug 31 → July 31 (31 days), → July 1 (30 more days) → June 1 (30 more days) → May 2 (31 more days) → May 1 (1 day) leaves 154 days to go.  
Continue: April (30), March (31), February (28), January (31) = 120 days, leaving 34 days before year start.  
34 days before Jan 1, 1967 is Nov 28, 1966 (since Dec has 31 days: 31-34 = -3 → Nov 30 minus 3 = Nov 27? Let’s check carefully).  

Better systematic:  
Days to subtract after reaching Jan 1, 1967:  
From Sep 10 to Jan 1: Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) = 243 days in Jan–Aug, plus days from Sep 1 to Sep 10 = 10 days, total 253 days before Jan 1.  
We need to go back 257 days from Sep 10, 1967 → 4 days before Jan 1, 1967.  
4 days before Jan 1, 1967 = Dec 28, 1966 (Dec 31 → 30 (1), 29 (2), 28 (3), 27 (4)? Wait, Jan 1 minus 1 day = Dec 31, minus 2 = Dec 30, minus 3 = Dec 29, minus 4 = Dec 28). Yes.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1966-12-28
